limits: No live native process or game playing used. Static source pose is not runtime clip selection/flags/TRS bit certification.
Only static geometry collisions are measured. Poison/DOT hazards, sequence effects, billboard animation, Siege rules and destruction resources must remain explicitly qualified.
Spawn tests are current S5 Controller behavior on intact source meshes, not native spawn-selection allocation.
Native bounds helpers and role masks are retained as source metadata; no invented collision or passage opening.
